senses.gloss: an activity or event that lasts a very long time
senses.example: The negotiations became a marathon that continued late into the night.

translations.zh_TW: 馬拉松式的活動；持久戰
translations.ja_JP: 長丁場；マラソン的イベント

example_translations.zh_TW: 談判變成了一場馬拉松，一直持續到深夜。
example_translations.ja_JP: 交渉は長丁場となり、夜遅くまで続きました。
